notes: All four cited sources opened directly (downloaded and text-matched, not summarized): NRS ch. 239 (leg.state.nv.us, page stamp 'Rev. 4/15/2026 --2025', i.e. current through the 2025 83rd Session), NAC ch. 239 (Rev. 4/13/2026), S.B. 287 (2019) enrolled PDF, and the 2020 State Library manual PDF (admin.nv.gov). AB 51 (2025) death corroborated by 2025-2026 Nevada press (Nevada Independent; This Is Reno).
